Residential · Commercial · Community

Whoever said a great neighborhood had to be ordinary? Parmer Development is Auburn's premier residential developer, creating resort-style communities for both first-year students and long-time Auburn residents. Featuring thoughtfully designed interiors, upscale finishes, and unmatched attention to detail, our neighborhoods offer everything you need to feel at home. Experience the difference of purpose-driven development — private bedrooms, quality craftsmanship, and community spaces built around the people who call Auburn home. Contact our leasing team today to learn more about available floor plans and upcoming communities.
